fullDescription: A tactile 3D 'pushable' button system on a light base: cobalt gradient button faces with a real bottom edge that lifts on hover and compresses on press, with every variant, size and state and an anatomy breakdown, in Inter.

structured.summary: A tactile 3D 'pushable' BUTTON SYSTEM showcase page on a light off-white base (#f6f7fb), framed as a single 'Pressable' canvas. The signature is a button built from three stacked layers, a blurred ground shadow, a darker static bottom edge, and a raised gradient front that visibly compresses when pressed, so every button reads as a physical key you can push. A blurred sticky nav (a cobalt gradient rounded-orb logo with a cursor-click icon, a 'Pressable.' wordmark, four anchor links, a 'Docs' link, and a small cobalt 'Copy prompt' button) sits over a full-bleed hero with a faint dotted-grid backdrop and two big blurred floating color blobs (cobalt + amber). The hero centers an eyebrow pill ('Prompt Library · Button Design'), a huge black headline 'Buttons that push back.' where 'push back.' carries an amber highlighter swipe, a muted subhead, a 3D cobalt 'Press me' + light 'See it move' CTA pair, and a hint line. The body is a stack of white rounded showcase cards, each with a numbered icon-tile header: 01 Variants (six tactile fills, cobalt / amber / light / ink / ghost / icon-only), 02 Sizes (sm/md/lg + full-width block), 03 States (rest, hover-lift, pressed-compress, loading spinner, disabled-flat), and a two-column 04 Anatomy row that explodes the three layers (front / edge / shadow) beside a 'The prompt' card with a 'Remix this prompt' button. It closes on a minimal white footer with the brand cluster and four anchor links.

style.description: A clean, modern, tactile aesthetic where the whole personality is physical depth, every button is a 3D 'pushable' key that lifts on hover and compresses on press. The base is a soft off-white #f6f7fb with crisp near-black ink text (#0f1424) and a muted slate body color (#5b6178). The hero accent is a confident cobalt blue used as a 5-step gradient face, paired with a single warm amber as the secondary/attention color. Inter is the only typeface (weights 400-900), with black (900) tracking-tight display headlines, extrabold (800) section titles, and bold (700) button labels. Surfaces are airy and friendly: a faint cobalt radial dot-grid backdrop behind the hero, two big blurred floating color orbs (cobalt-200/40 + amber-300/30), and white .swatch-card panels with rounded-[22px] corners, a 1px #eceef5 border, and a soft layered drop shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,20,36,.04), 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(15,20,36,.18)). The signature is the 3D button itself, three stacked absolutely-positioned layers (a blurred bottom shadow, a static darker 'edge' base, and a raised gradient 'front' that sits translateY(-5px) at rest), animated with a springy transform transition cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1): hover lifts the front to -7px and drops the shadow, :active snaps the front to -2px in 34ms so it physically presses in. Iconography is Iconify ph (phosphor) glyphs. Nothing is flat, the depth, the gradient faces, and the press physics carry the identity.
style.prompt: Build a tactile, modern 3D 'pushable' button system on a light base. Set body background #f6f7fb, text color #0f1424 (ink), antialiased. Font: Inter ONLY (Google Fonts, weights 400;500;600;700;800;900) as the sans family; display headlines font-black (900) tracking-[-.03em], section titles font-extrabold (800), button labels font-bold (700) letter-spacing .1px. Define the palette via Tailwind config extend.colors: cobalt 50 #eef2ff, 100 #e0e7ff, 200 #c7d2fe, 300 #a5b4ff, 400 #7c8cff, 500 #4f6bff, 600 #1f4fff, 700 #1539d6, 800 #142fa8, 900 #162a82; amber 300 #ffd089, 400 #ffb84d, 500 #ff9e2c, 600 #f5851f; ink #0f1424. Muted body text is #5b6178. The core is the 3D pushable button .pb: position relative, transparent border-none background, padding 0, cursor pointer, outline-offset 4px, transition filter .25s. It has three stacked children, all border-radius 14px: .pb__shadow (absolute inset-0, background rgba(15,20,36,.18), transform translateY(2px), transition transform .6s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1)); .pb__edge (absolute inset-0, a darker static base, a left-to-right gradient for rounded-corner shading); and .pb__front (block relative, font-weight 700, transform translateY(-5px), the same .6s springy transition). Hover: .pb filter brightness(1.04), .pb__front transform translateY(-7px) and .pb__shadow translateY(5px) (both fast .25s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1.5)). Active (pressed): .pb__front translateY(-2px) and .pb__shadow translateY(1px) in .034s, so it snaps in. focus-visible: front box-shadow 0 0 0 3px #f6f7fb, 0 0 0 6px #4f6bff. Surfaces: .swatch-card = background #fff, 1px #eceef5 border, border-radius 22px, box-shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(15,20,36,.04), 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(15,20,36,.18). Backdrop: .dotgrid = radial-gradient(rgba(31,79,255,.10) 1px, transparent 1px) at background-size 22px 22px; .nav-blur = background rgba(246,247,251,.78), backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(14px); .hero-orb = radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #3a64ff, #1f4fff 55%, #142fa8 100%). Icons are Iconify ph (phosphor) loaded from code.iconify.design. Keep everything crisp, light, depth-driven and friendly, the physics and the gradient button faces are the whole point. No em-dashes in any copy.

layout_and_structure.description: A single full-bleed marketing-style canvas in a centered max-w-[1180px] column with px-6 gutters. Top to bottom: a sticky blurred nav (h-[68px]), a full-bleed dotted-grid hero with floating blobs (centered text block + 3D CTA pair + hint line), a main stack of white .swatch-card showcase sections spaced space-y-7 (01 Variants, 02 Sizes, 03 States, then a lg:grid-cols-5 04 Anatomy row split into a 3-col anatomy card + 2-col 'The prompt' card), and a minimal full-bleed white footer. The hero headline scales 44px -> sm:64px; nav center links and the 'Docs' link hide on small screens; the Variants grid is grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-3; the States grid is grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-5; the Anatomy row stacks to one column below lg; footer reflows row -> column on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with .nav-blur (background rgba(246,247,251,.78), backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(14px)) and a bottom border-[#e7e9f2]. Inside a mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 row, h-[68px], items-center justified-between: LEFT = a brand link (gap-2.5), a 36px (w-9 h-9) rounded-xl .hero-orb tile (radial cobalt gradient) with a shadow and a white Iconify ph:cursor-click-fill icon at 20px, then a 17px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Pressable' with a cobalt-600 period '.'; CENTER (hidden below md, gap-8, 14px font-medium text-[#5b6178]) = four anchors 'Variants / Sizes / States / Anatomy' that hover to text-ink; RIGHT (gap-3) = a 14px font-semibold text-[#5b6178] 'Docs' link (hidden on the smallest screens) and a small 3D cobalt button (.pb .pb--cobalt .pb--sm) reading 'Copy prompt' with a trailing ph:copy-bold icon.

A relative overflow-hidden full-bleed section with the .dotgrid backdrop and a bottom border-[#e7e9f2]. Background layers: an absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-[420px] h-[420px] rounded-full bg-cobalt-200/40 blur-3xl orb, and an absolute -bottom-32 -left-20 w-[380px] h-[380px] rounded-full bg-amber-300/30 blur-3xl orb. In a relative mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 pt-20 pb-24 text-center column: an eyebrow pill (inline-flex rounded-full bg-white border border-cobalt-100 px-3.5 py-1.5, 12.5px font-semibold text-cobalt-700, shadow-sm) with a ph:cube-bold icon + 'Prompt Library · Button Design'; a mt-6 text-[44px] -> sm:text-[64px] font-black tracking-[-.03em] leading-[1.04] text-ink h1 reading 'Buttons that push back.' where 'push back.' is a relative inline-block span sitting above an absolute amber highlighter swipe (bottom-1.5 h-3.5 bg-amber-300/60 rounded); a mx-auto mt-5 max-w-[560px] text-[17px] leading-relaxed text-[#5b6178] subhead 'A tactile 3D button system with a real bottom edge that compresses on press. Every variant, size, and state, generated from one prompt.'; a mt-9 flex-wrap justify-center gap-4 CTA pair, a 3D cobalt LG button 'Press me' (trailing ph:arrow-down-bold) and a 3D light LG button 'See it move' (leading ph:play-fill in cobalt); then a mt-7 13px text-[#5b6178] hint row (ph:hand-pointing-fill cobalt-500 icon) reading 'Hover to lift, click to compress. Built with pure CSS transforms.'

A .swatch-card p-8 -> sm:p-10 (id=variants, scroll-mt-24). Header row (flex items-start gap-4): a 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-2xl bg-cobalt-50 text-cobalt-600 tile holding a black '01', beside a text-[24px] -> sm:text-[27px] font-extrabold tracking-tight 'Variants' title and a 15px text-[#5b6178] line 'Six tactile fills. Same physics, different intent, from loud cobalt to quiet ghost.' Body = a mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-3 gap-x-8 gap-y-10 of six samples, each a flex-col items-start gap-3 with an uppercase label-chip, a 3D medium button, and a 12.5px text-[#5b6178] caption: Primary (.pb--cobalt, ph:lightning-fill 'Get started', 'High-emphasis action'); Warm (.pb--amber, ph:sparkle-fill 'Upgrade', 'Secondary, attention-grabbing'); Neutral (.pb--light, ph:download-simple-bold cobalt 'Download', 'Low-emphasis, on light'); Ink (.pb--ink, ph:github-logo-fill 'View source', 'Dark, high-contrast'); Ghost (.pb--ghost, ph:bookmark-simple-bold 'Save', 'Outlined, tertiary'); and Icon (two icon-only square buttons, a .pb--cobalt ph:plus-bold and a .pb--light ph:heart-fill in amber, 'Square, single-glyph').

A .swatch-card p-8 -> sm:p-10 (id=sizes, scroll-mt-24). Header: a 44px rounded-2xl bg-amber-300/30 text-amber-600 tile with a black '02', a 'Sizes' title and a 15px text-[#5b6178] line 'Three scales share one rhythm. The edge depth and radius scale with the front.' Body = a mt-9 flex-wrap items-end gap-x-10 gap-y-8 of four samples (each flex-col items-start gap-3 with an uppercase label-chip caption above a 3D cobalt button): 'Small · 13px' (.pb--sm 'Small'), 'Medium · 15px' (.pb--md 'Medium'), 'Large · 17px' (.pb--lg 'Large'), and a grow min-w-[200px] 'Full width · block' (.pb--md w-full 'Add to cart' with a leading ph:shopping-cart-simple-fill, the .pb__front w-full centered).

A .swatch-card p-8 -> sm:p-10 (id=states, scroll-mt-24). Header: a 44px rounded-2xl bg-cobalt-50 text-cobalt-600 tile with a black '03', a 'States' title and a 15px text-[#5b6178] line 'Rest, hover-lift, pressed-compress, loading, and disabled, the full interaction map.' Body = a mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-5 gap-x-6 gap-y-9 of five samples (each flex-col items-start gap-3, an uppercase label-chip, a cobalt button, a 12px text-[#5b6178] caption): Rest (.pb--cobalt 'Default', 'edge fully shown'); Hover (a .pb--cobalt statically forced to the lifted look, front translateY(-7px) + shadow translateY(5px) + brightness(1.04), 'Lifted', 'front rises'); Pressed (.pb--cobalt .pb--pressed 'Pushed', 'edge compresses'); Loading (.pb--cobalt with a .pb__spin spinner + 'Saving', 'async in flight'); Disabled (.pb--disabled disabled 'Unavailable', 'flat, no depth').

A grid lg:grid-cols-5 gap-7 (id=anatomy, scroll-mt-24). LEFT a lg:col-span-3 .swatch-card p-8 -> sm:p-10: header with a 44px rounded-2xl bg-ink text-white tile holding a black '04', an 'Anatomy' title and a 15px text-[#5b6178] line 'Three stacked layers create the push: a soft drop shadow, a darker static edge, and a raised front that travels down on press.' Body = a mt-9 flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center gap-10: a w-full sm:w-[230px] py-8 rounded-2xl bg-cobalt-50/60 grid-place-items-center panel holding one big scaled .pb--cobalt button ('Layered', transform scale(1.45)), beside a space-y-4 14.5px numbered list (each li a cobalt-100 numbered chip + a bold ink term + muted gloss): 1 'Front' (the cobalt gradient face you read and click, travels -5px at rest), 2 'Edge' (a static darker base giving the visible thickness), 3 'Shadow' (a blurred ground shadow that contracts on press). RIGHT a lg:col-span-2 .swatch-card p-8 -> sm:p-10 flex-col 'The prompt' card: an uppercase cobalt-600 label-chip 'The prompt', a 16px leading-relaxed text-ink font-medium quoted prompt paragraph, then mt-auto a full-width 3D cobalt button (.pb--md w-full 'Remix this prompt', leading ph:magic-wand-fill) over a centered 12.5px text-[#5b6178] caption 'Opens in the Superdesign canvas'.

A full-bleed footer with a top border-[#e7e9f2] and bg-white. Inside a mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 py-10 flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justified-between gap-5: LEFT a brand cluster (a 32px w-8 h-8 rounded-lg .hero-orb tile with a white ph:cursor-click-fill icon, a font-bold 15px 'Pressable' wordmark with a cobalt-600 period, and a 13px text-[#5b6178] line 'a button system from the prompt library'); RIGHT a gap-6 row of four 13.5px font-medium text-[#5b6178] anchor links 'Variants / States / Anatomy / GitHub' that hover to text-ink.

special_ui_components.prompt: The signature component, a button built from three stacked absolutely-positioned layers so it reads as a physical key. .pb = position relative, border none, background transparent, padding 0, cursor pointer, outline-offset 4px, transition filter .25s. All three children are border-radius 14px: .pb__shadow (absolute inset-0, background rgba(15,20,36,.18), transform translateY(2px), transition transform .6s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1)) is the blurred ground shadow; .pb__edge (absolute inset-0) is a static darker base whose left-to-right gradient shades the rounded corners; .pb__front (display block, position relative, font-weight 700, letter-spacing .1px, transform translateY(-5px), the same .6s springy transition) is the raised gradient face you read and click. The depth = the front sitting -5px above the edge. NOTE the markup order inside each button: shadow, then edge, then front.

Hover: .pb filter brightness(1.04); .pb__front transform translateY(-7px) and .pb__shadow translateY(5px), both in a fast .25s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1.5) (the front rises, the ground shadow spreads). Active/pressed: .pb__front translateY(-2px) and .pb__shadow translateY(1px) in just .034s, so the button snaps physically inward. focus-visible: .pb__front box-shadow 0 0 0 3px #f6f7fb, 0 0 0 6px #4f6bff (a double ring). A static .pb--pressed helper locks the compressed look for demos (front translateY(-1px)!important + brightness(.97), shadow translateY(0)!important + opacity .6).

Each variant styles .pb__edge (a left-to-right gradient: darker at the ends, base in the middle, e.g. linear-gradient(to left, DARK 0%, BASE 8%, BASE 92%, DARK 100%)) and .pb__front (a top-to-bottom 180deg gradient face). .pb--cobalt: edge linear-gradient(to left,#0e2bb0,#1539d6,#1539d6,#0e2bb0), front linear-gradient(180deg,#3a64ff 0%,#1f4fff 100%) white text. .pb--amber: edge from #c75e06/#e0700f, front linear-gradient(180deg,#ffb04a,#ff9e2c) with #3a1d00 text. .pb--light: edge from #c2c8da/#d6dbe8, front linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f2f4fa) #1f2a44 text + inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,20,36,.05). .pb--ink: edge from #050813/#11182e, front linear-gradient(180deg,#2a3450,#161c2e) white text. .pb--ghost: edge from #b9c2ee/#cdd5f7, front flat #eef2ff with #1539d6 text + inset 0 0 0 1.5px #c7d2fe ring. .pb--disabled: front flat #e7e9f0 / #a3a9bd text, edge flat #d3d7e2, shadow opacity 0, cursor not-allowed (a flat, depthless treatment).

Sizes scale only the .pb__front padding and font-size while the 14px radius and the layer offsets stay constant: .pb--sm .pb__front = padding 9px 18px, font-size 13px; .pb--md .pb__front = padding 13px 26px, font-size 15px; .pb--lg .pb__front = padding 18px 36px, font-size 17px. Icon-only buttons force a square front (.pb__front grid place-items-center !px-[15px]).

.pb__spin = an inline-block 1em x 1em circle, border 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45) with border-top-color #fff, border-radius 50%, vertical-align -2px, animation spin .7s linear infinite (@keyframes spin to transform rotate(360deg)). Drop it inside the .pb__front next to a label like 'Saving' for the loading state.

.dotgrid = a radial-gradient(rgba(31,79,255,.10) 1px, transparent 1px) tiled at 22px 22px behind the hero. .nav-blur = background rgba(246,247,251,.78), backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(14px) for the sticky header. .hero-orb = a radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #3a64ff, #1f4fff 55%, #142fa8 100%) cobalt sphere used for the logo tiles. Behind the hero text sit two big blur-3xl color orbs (a bg-cobalt-200/40 top-right and a bg-amber-300/30 bottom-left) for soft atmosphere.

structured.special_notes: A tactile, modern 3D 'pushable' button SYSTEM on a light base, the whole personality is physical depth + press physics. Exact palette via Tailwind config: cobalt 50 #eef2ff / 100 #e0e7ff / 200 #c7d2fe / 300 #a5b4ff / 400 #7c8cff / 500 #4f6bff / 600 #1f4fff / 700 #1539d6 / 800 #142fa8 / 900 #162a82; amber 300 #ffd089 / 400 #ffb84d / 500 #ff9e2c / 600 #f5851f; ink #0f1424; body bg #f6f7fb; muted body text #5b6178. The 3D button is three stacked border-radius:14px layers, .pb__shadow (rgba(15,20,36,.18), translateY(2px)) + .pb__edge (static darker left-to-right gradient base) + .pb__front (raised gradient face, translateY(-5px) at rest), all on a transform transition .6s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1). Press physics: hover front -> -7px + shadow -> 5px (fast .25s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1.5) + brightness 1.04); active front -> -2px + shadow -> 1px in .034s (snaps in); focus-visible double ring 0 0 0 3px #f6f7fb, 0 0 0 6px #4f6bff. Variant FRONT gradients (180deg): cobalt #3a64ff->#1f4fff white; amber #ffb04a->#ff9e2c on #3a1d00; light #ffffff->#f2f4fa on #1f2a44; ink #2a3450->#161c2e white; ghost flat #eef2ff on #1539d6 + inset ring #c7d2fe; disabled flat #e7e9f0/#a3a9bd, edge #d3d7e2, no shadow. EDGE gradients run to-left DARK/BASE/BASE/DARK (cobalt #0e2bb0/#1539d6, amber #c75e06/#e0700f, light #c2c8da/#d6dbe8, ink #050813/#11182e, ghost #b9c2ee/#cdd5f7). Sizes scale only .pb__front padding/font: sm 9px 18px /13px, md 13px 26px /15px, lg 18px 36px /17px. Loading .pb__spin = a .7s white-top spinner. Surfaces: .swatch-card = #fff, 1px #eceef5 border, radius 22px, box-shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(15,20,36,.04), 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(15,20,36,.18). Backdrop: .dotgrid radial-gradient(rgba(31,79,255,.10) 1px) at 22px, .nav-blur rgba(246,247,251,.78)+saturate(160%) blur(14px), .hero-orb radial cobalt sphere. Font: Inter ONLY (Google Fonts 400-900), font-black (900) tracking-[-.03em] headlines, extrabold (800) section titles, bold (700) buttons. Icons are Iconify ph (phosphor) from code.iconify.design (cursor-click-fill, copy-bold, cube-bold, arrow-down-bold, play-fill, hand-pointing-fill, lightning-fill, sparkle-fill, download-simple-bold, github-logo-fill, bookmark-simple-bold, plus-bold, heart-fill, shopping-cart-simple-fill, magic-wand-fill). To transfer the STYLE keep the off-white base + cobalt-gradient button faces + single amber accent + Inter, and above all the three-layer 3D depth with the springy hover-lift / fast active-compress physics. To transfer the LAYOUT keep the single marketing canvas (sticky blurred nav -> dotted-grid hero with floating orbs and a highlighter-swiped headline -> white showcase cards 01 Variants / 02 Sizes / 03 States, each with a numbered icon-tile header -> a two-column 04 Anatomy + 'The prompt' row -> minimal footer) and the 'labelled button above a caption' demo grids. No em-dashes in any copy.
